reader.requirement: At --std 85 INSPECT (every format) must admit as identifier-1 any group item (whatever its leaves' usages) and any elementary item of any category whose usage is DISPLAY (numeric signed and separate, numeric-edited, alphabetic, alphanumeric, a reference modification, an alphanumeric function-identifier in Format 1), and must refuse an elementary COMPUTATIONAL or INDEX item, an index-name and a numeric or integer function-identifier.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 a numeric/integer function-identifier written as an identifier is additionally refused COBOL0900 (construct numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002, §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4); the SR1 usage refusal COBOL1626 that follows is the same arm as 2023
when identifier-1 of a Format 3 depends on an ODO object: freeze its length once (2002+) or re-read it for the REPLACING half (85); not the SR1 screen

reader.edition-search: IsInspectIdentifier1 / IsInspectElementaryCharacterItem / CheckInspectIdentifier1FunctionUsage read no edition (grep DialectLevel|Edition.Year|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior in StatementValidation's INSPECT block and InspectBinder.Bind); the 2023 arm's narrowing to alphanumeric/national groups cannot differ at 85, where no bit, strongly-typed or national group can be declared
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for SR1 itself; yes beside it: a numeric function-identifier is also COBOL0900 at 85 (it may appear only in an arithmetic expression there)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise only the numeric/integer function-identifier refusal; group, usage DISPLAY categories, COMP, INDEX and index-name were not exercised by them

probes.expected: group with a COMP leaf, signed separate numeric (TALLYING and REPLACING), numeric-edited, alphabetic, an ODO group at 3 and 6, and G(3:2) are all admitted and counted correctly

probes.printed: COBOL1626 INSPECT identifier-1 'CB' is an elementary item of USAGE Binary
COBOL1626 'GB' (COMP leaf of a group as identifier-1)
COBOL1637 index-name 'TI' is not an identifier
COBOL0900 numeric function-identifier as identifier requires COBOL-2002 + COBOL1626

probes.expected: alphanumeric function UPPER-CASE admitted in Format 1; ABCA holds 2 A

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.18.3 SR1  (6.18.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: One edition-blind predicate (group of alphanumeric/national kind or elementary display/national reference) answers SR1; at 85 every declarable group is alphanumeric, so the 2023 narrowing cannot over-reject. Diagnostics cite §2023:14.9.22.3 SR1 at --std 85 (cosmetic).

refuter.evidence: Attacked the 2023 arm's 'alphanumeric or national GROUP' narrowing against 1985's plain 'group item', and the 1985 usages BINARY and PACKED-DECIMAL. Probes at --std 85: r3gcomp (01 G USAGE COMP at group level) -> admitted, G=0004; r3gidx (01 G USAGE INDEX group; group of COMP+X with REPLACING) -> admitted, G=0016, H2=B; r3ren (66 RENAMES THRU, 66 alias of a DISPLAY item, alphanumeric-edited X(2)BX TALLYING and REPLACING, PIC 9PP) -> RT=0002 RX=0001 AE=0003 AE2=QQ Q NP=0001; r3disp (embedded-sign S9(4) REPLACING, numeric-edited CONVERTING, group CONVERTING, Format 3 on a group with a COMP leaf) -> ST=-3232 NE=  1.55 GD=XYXY G=ZBC 0001; r3bin (BINARY) and r3pd (PACKED-DECIMAL) -> COBOL1626; r3rencomp (66 alias of a COMP elementary) -> COBOL1626 (message names R2, not RC: cosmetic). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.18.3 SR1 'either a group item or any category of elementary item'; OK §1985:VI.5.14.4 GR1 'If the USAGE clause is written at a group level'.
